_doc: Standing orders (src/player/standingOrders.js). What the character does with the day's spare points when the day ends (End Turn, or each day of a Wait): self-care first (data/autoUpkeep.json), then the order uses what is left, once a day, through the game's own actions at their own costs: odd jobs (player/oddJobs.js, paid out of the town's purse), the quick forage (player/foraging.js) or the quick fishing trip (systems/foodSkills.js), sparring with the town's trainer (the fee to the town), collecting stored goods from your properties and herds, drilling your soldiers (their kits wear), prayer or meditation (systems/devotion.js). An order that can't run where you stand says why and you rest instead. Set from the Wait panel (Pass the Time).

rest.name: Rest only
rest.desc: Nothing more: the spare hours go on rest.

work.name: Work in town
work.desc: A day's labour in town; your trade's work first (a smith strikes at the forge, a woodcutter cuts wood).

fell._comment: One tree a day (player/gathering.js): the swings it takes (strength, luck, its hardness, Woodcutting, the best axe, a logging camp on the hex) each tire and teach as on the inner map; Gathering.felled gives the logs (a camp's yield boost), the extra share and what else it gives. maxSwings caps a day's work.

hunt._comment: As Hunt (4 AP), its quick path: needs a bow and arrows or a crossbow and bolts (player/huntingBow.js quickShots: arrows used and recovered, bow wear); the quarry through Hunting.quickHunt.

estates.name: Tend your holdings
estates.desc: Collect the goods your properties and beasts have stored where you stand.

train.name: Train at arms
train.desc: Spar with the town's trainer for a fee; your soldiers drill alongside.

gather.name: Forage or fish
gather.desc: Search the wilds for herbs and useful things, or fish where there is water.

fell.name: Fell timber
fell.desc: Fell a tree in the woods: its logs and what else it gives, more with Woodcutting, an axe, and a logging camp of yours on the hex.

hunt.name: Hunt
hunt.desc: A day's hunt in the wilds with your bow or crossbow: arrows loosed, some recovered, the quarry if one strikes home.

drill.name: Drill your soldiers
drill.desc: Put your companies through their drill: experience for green men, wear on their kit.

devotion.name: Pray and study
devotion.desc: Prayer at a church or holy site, meditation elsewhere: rest, karma, sometimes insight.

work._comment: ap and needs as the Look for Work action (ui/actionMenu/core.js AP_COSTS.odd_jobs). score: the performance the day's work is paid for (the quick path's 40). professionWeight: how much a practised skill a job trains counts when choosing the job.

gather._comment: forage / fish as the Forage (3 AP) and Go Fishing (3 AP) actions. fishFirstBelow: with fewer meals than this in the pack, fishing comes before foraging.

train._comment: As Combat Training (4 AP), its quick path: the fee (capital/elsewhere) is paid into the town's purse; skillChance of +1 combat; armyXp to each unit. keepGold: the fee is never paid out of the last of the purse.

drill._comment: Drilling: xp per unit a day; drill alone makes no veterans past maxLevel (battle does); kitWear: condition points off each unit's kit (systems/arms.js wearKits).

devotion._comment: As Meditate (3 AP): its need effects; quality is the devotion model's 0..1 (the minigame's middle).
